title: Donna's Got It
overview: A heartwarming comedy about resilience, self-belief, and the magic that happens when you stop chasing the rat race and start trusting your own rhythm. Donna is a hopeful Macedonian-Australian actress who refuses to give up on her dream. No matter how many rejections she gets or how quiet the phone stays. From auditions in her home studio to her Croatian roommate's "helpful" advice, Donna is determined to "make it".
